title: The interior balanced-submatrix conjecture
statement:
Let $A\text{ }\in\mathcal{B}_{n}(\mathbb{R})$ be a square balanced matrix. An **interior balanced-submatrix conjecture** asserts that some interior of $A$, meaning a submatrix of $A$, is also balanced.

This would assert that every square balanced matrix contains a balanced submatrix. The source provides no resolution or further context for this claim.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.07542

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2018).
source_name: Theophilus Agama and Gael Kibiti, “Balanced matrices”, arXiv:1810.07542 (2026).
